title: Ordinary tensor homology for modules over a constant field quotient
statement: Let T be a scheme and A a commutative ring. On the original small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], write R_A for the constant commutative ring sheaf and use its intrinsic module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let r in A generate a maximal ideal, put k=A/(r), and let N be the unit module of the constant ring sheaf R_k, restricted to R_A by the canonical quotient map (the coefficient module used in [def-weil-derived-tensor]). Let P be any possibly unbounded cochain complex of R_A-modules and let M be any R_A-module sheaf annihilated by the canonical constant sections of r. For every integer i, if H^i of the ordinary termwise sheaf tensor P tensor N is zero, then H^i of P tensor M is zero. Tensor is [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. No K-flatness, nilpotence, constructibility or interval hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 03CY, 0GMW and 03EI; original residue-test proof step 3

proof.text: Construct the residue-presheaf action on the underlying additive sheaf of M using Module.IsTorsionBy.module sectionwise. Restrictions are linear since quotient representatives lift to A. Extend this action along the locally bijective constant-ring unit by PresheafOfModules.sheafify, using the identity on the additive sheaf. Naturality of constant sheafification and local surjectivity of the A-unit identify restriction of this new residue-field module MB with M.

source.place: Converse, residue-field module calculation before the uniformizer filtration

proof.text: Form the additive scalar-extension functor E by sectionwise ModuleCat.extendScalars and module sheafification. Write U for restriction of scalars. The proved scalar-tensor cancellation is natural in both variables, hence gives E followed by tensorLeft L followed by U isomorphic to tensorLeft (U L). At the regular residue-field module the left unitor identifies E followed by U with tensorLeft N. Restriction U is faithful and exact because it preserves the underlying additive sheaf; use the proved restriction-exact helper in RingedToposFlatPullback.

source.place: Converse, residue-field module calculation before the uniformizer filtration

proof.text: Translate homology vanishing into exactness of the three-term short complex P.sc i. The hypothesis and the regular-module comparison imply exactness of its scalar extension, since faithful exact scalar restriction reflects exactness. Maximality makes A/(r) a field. Every module over its constant sheaf is flat. Transfer its exact site-tensor functor to the monoidal tensor using siteSheafTensorRightIso, and use symmetry to tensor on the left by MB.

source.place: Converse, residue-field module calculation before the uniformizer filtration

proof.text: Apply exact restriction U and scalar-tensor cancellation at MB to identify the resulting exact short complex with P.sc i tensorLeft (U MB). Transport across U MB isomorphic to M, then use symmetry and exactAt_iff_isZero_homology to conclude the stated tensorRight M homology vanishing. This uses neither stalks nor sectionwise homology vanishing and works for all integers and the empty scheme.

proof_origin.place: Q7: ordinary scalar-tensor cancellation, faithful exact restriction and flatness over the constant residue field; no separate cohomology comparison needed

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_residue_module_tensor_homology
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : A)
    (hr : (Ideal.span {r}).IsMaximal)
    (P : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) ℤ)
    (M : proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A))
    (hM : ∀ (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U),
      (toSheafify (ProEt.topology T)
        ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))).app U
          (ULift.up r) • x = 0)
    (i : ℤ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (proEtaleConstantRing T A)
    let B := A ⧸ Ideal.span {r}
    let RB := proEtaleConstantRing T B
    let SB := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology T) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj RB
    let α := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology T) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map
      ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.ulift (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})))))
    let N := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u + 1} α).obj (SheafOfModules.unit SB)
    IsZero ((((tensorRight N).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).homology i) →
    IsZero ((((tensorRight M).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).homology i)
